I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in the loop in `tests/test_payments.py`. That's about 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's limit of 5. I haven't run the test, so I haven't confirmed the CI flake is gone.

The delay is a `REQUEST_SPACING_S` constant at the top of the file, so you can change it in one place. The sleep also runs after the last request, which adds a harmless 0.25s.

I also saved a note about the 5 req/s sandbox limit to the project's EngramDB memory.
